body_html: Hi, Nikolas here, co-founder of ApyHub. Did the new Actors ever climb into the top five, or do you send people the direct link? We don't have SEC EDGAR data in the catalog yet, so you could list it on ApyHub too: around 10 minutes, no exclusivity, and from our experience at ApyHub agents call it through our MCP without you building anything extra, we handle billing. apyhub.com/become-a-provider

Reading this from the calling side (I build GTM lists with agents, I do not publish Actors): the two things that made me trust an Actor enough to put it in a prompt last month are exactly the ones you describe. A free count or preview mode, so the agent can size a segment and report the price before it spends anything, and a README that states the limit of the data (how fresh the dates are, which months are thin) instead of hiding it. The charge cap per run is the third thing I check. With those three, "count first, then buy" becomes a one-line instruction and the agent stops being scary to point at a metered API.

The checklist at the end is good. I would add one item from the user's chair: an example input in the README that an agent can copy verbatim, because that is what it does.
